title: layout changed
description: Card positions of a view were saved. A layout is not a design change, so it has an event of its own, and a board open on the same design moves its cards without reloading.

source.description: /designer/<design>: the event comes from e-designer and names the design it serves, so a reader listening to many products knows which design changed (ADR-E2).

data.description: Which view of which design was saved.

design.description: The id of the design whose layout changed, so a board acts only when it shows that design.

view.description: The view whose card positions were saved, so a board redraws it when that view is shown.
